name: cable lying biceps curl v. 2
description: Lying on your back with a cable pulling from the floor, you curl the handle toward your shoulders to isolate the biceps under steady tension.
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor facing the cable stack and hold the bar or handle with palms up.
Keep your upper arms still and pinned to the floor.
Curl the handle toward your shoulders, squeezing the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your back flat and avoid lifting your shoulders as you curl.
